choose.when: AND x.community_key = (SELECT community_key FROM theme.sp_plot WHERE plot_key = #{key})

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS "projects", round(coalesce(sum(x.approved_budget), 0), 0) AS "budgetAed", round(coalesce(sum(x.cumulative_expenditures), 0), 0) AS "spentAed", CASE WHEN sum(x.approved_budget) > 0 THEN round(100.0 * sum(x.cumulative_expenditures) / sum(x.approved_budget), 1) END AS "spentPct", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.completed) AS "completed", count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT coalesce(x.completed, false)) AS "ongoing", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.delayed) AS "delayed", round(coalesce(sum(x.approved_budget) FILTER (WHERE x.delayed), 0), 0) AS "delayedBudgetAed", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.geom IS NOT NULL) AS "mapped" FROM theme.dev_capital_project x WHERE true

SELECT coalesce(nullif(x.${dim}, ''), 'Unknown') AS "k", count(*) AS "n", round(coalesce(sum(x.approved_budget), 0), 0) AS "budgetAed", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.delayed) AS "delayed" FROM theme.dev_capital_project x WHERE true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT x.project_id AS "projectId", x.project_name AS "name", x.category AS "category", x.phase AS "phase", x.status AS "status", round(x.approved_budget, 0) AS "budgetAed", round(x.cumulative_expenditures, 0) AS "spentAed", CASE WHEN x.approved_budget > 0 THEN round(100.0 * x.cumulative_expenditures / x.approved_budget, 1) END AS "spentPct", x.actual_progress AS "actualProgress", x.revised_progress AS "plannedProgress", x.original_progress AS "originalProgress", x.original_planned_com_date AS "plannedEnd", x.actual_forecast_com_date AS "forecastEnd", x.delayed AS "delayed", x.completed AS "completed", x.contractor_name AS "contractor", x.district_key AS "districtKey", ST_X(x.centroid) AS "cx", ST_Y(x.centroid) AS "cy" FROM theme.dev_capital_project x WHERE true ORDER BY x.delayed DESC NULLS LAST, x.approved_budget DESC NULLS LAST, x.project_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: coalesce(x.permit_status, '') !~* '(expir|cancel|revok|reject|closed|suspend)' AND x.project_completion_date IS NULL AND coalesce(x.project_status, '') !~* 'complet'
mapper.select: WITH a AS (SELECT max(issuing_date) AS d FROM theme.dev_permit) SELECT (SELECT d FROM a) AS "asOf", count(*) AS "permits", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.issuing_date > (SELECT d FROM a) - interval '12 months') AS "newLast12m", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.issuing_date > (SELECT d FROM a) - interval '6 months') AS "newLast6m", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.issuing_date > (SELECT d FROM a) - interval '12 months' AND x.issuing_date <= (SELECT d FROM a) - interval '6 months') AS "newPrev6m", count(*) FILTER (WHERE ) AS "inProgress", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.delayed_status ~* 'delay' AND x.delayed_variance_days > 180) AS "stalled180" FROM theme.dev_permit x WHERE true
SELECT coalesce(nullif(x.${dim}, ''), 'Unknown') AS "k", count(*) AS "n" FROM theme.dev_permit x WHERE true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT count(*) AS "applications", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.kind = 'completion') AS "completionCertificates", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.kind = 'maintenance') AS "maintenancePermits", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.kind = 'demolition') AS "demolitionPermits", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.kind = 'other') AS "other" FROM theme.dev_building_application x WHERE true
SELECT coalesce(x.project_type_name, 'Unknown') AS "k", max(x.kind) AS "kind", count(*) AS "n" FROM theme.dev_building_application x WHERE true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15

WITH a AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', max(submission_date))::date AS m FROM theme.dev_building_application), months AS (SELECT generate_series((SELECT m FROM a) - interval '11 months', (SELECT m FROM a), interval '1 month')::date AS m) SELECT to_char(months.m, 'YYYY-MM') AS "month", count(x.*) FILTER (WHERE x.kind = 'maintenance') AS "maintenance", count(x.*) FILTER (WHERE x.kind = 'demolition') AS "demolition", count(x.*) FILTER (WHERE x.kind = 'completion') AS "completion" FROM months LEFT JOIN theme.dev_building_application x ON date_trunc('month', x.submission_date) = months.m GROUP BY months.m ORDER BY months.m

WITH a AS (SELECT max(date_opened)::date AS d FROM theme.ops_case) SELECT (SELECT d FROM a) AS "asOf", count(*) AS "cases12m", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.closed) AS "closed12m", AS "closedPct", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.closed AND x.sla_color IS NOT NULL) AS "slaRated", AS "slaPct", avg(x.csat_score) AS "csat" FROM theme.ops_case x WHERE x.date_opened > (SELECT d FROM a) - interval '12 months'

WITH a AS (SELECT max(date_opened)::date AS d FROM theme.ops_case) SELECT coalesce(nullif(x.${dim}, ''), 'Unknown') AS "k", count(*) AS "n", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.closed) AS "closed" FROM theme.ops_case x WHERE x.date_opened > (SELECT d FROM a) - interval '12 months' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

WITH a AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', max(date_opened))::date AS m FROM theme.ops_case), months AS (SELECT generate_series((SELECT m FROM a) - interval '11 months', (SELECT m FROM a), interval '1 month')::date AS m) SELECT to_char(months.m, 'YYYY-MM') AS "month", (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.ops_case x WHERE date_trunc('month', x.date_opened) = months.m ) AS "opened", (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.ops_case x WHERE date_trunc('month', x.date_closed) = months.m ) AS "closed" FROM months ORDER BY months.m

WITH a AS (SELECT max(report_date)::date AS d FROM theme.ops_accident) SELECT (SELECT d FROM a) AS "asOf", count(*) AS "accidents12m" FROM theme.ops_accident x WHERE x.report_date > (SELECT d FROM a) - interval '12 months'

WITH a AS (SELECT max(report_date)::date AS d FROM theme.ops_accident) SELECT coalesce(nullif(x.${dim}, ''), 'Unknown') AS "k", count(*) AS "n" FROM theme.ops_accident x WHERE x.report_date > (SELECT d FROM a) - interval '12 months' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

WITH a AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', max(report_date))::date AS m FROM theme.ops_accident), months AS (SELECT generate_series((SELECT m FROM a) - interval '11 months', (SELECT m FROM a), interval '1 month')::date AS m) SELECT to_char(months.m, 'YYYY-MM') AS "month", count(x.*) AS "n" FROM months LEFT JOIN theme.ops_accident x ON date_trunc('month', x.report_date) = months.m GROUP BY months.m ORDER BY months.m

WITH a AS (SELECT max(raised_on)::date AS d FROM theme.ops_distortion) SELECT (SELECT d FROM a) AS "asOf", count(*) AS "reports12m", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.within_sla IS NOT NULL) AS "slaRated", AS "slaFixedPct", AS "duplicatePct", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.converted_to_violation) AS "convertedToViolation", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.closed_date IS NULL) AS "open" FROM theme.ops_distortion x WHERE x.raised_on > (SELECT d FROM a) - interval '12 months'

WITH a AS (SELECT max(raised_on)::date AS d FROM theme.ops_distortion) SELECT coalesce(nullif(x.${dim}, ''), 'Unknown') AS "k", count(*) AS "n", AS "slaFixedPct" FROM theme.ops_distortion x WHERE x.raised_on > (SELECT d FROM a) - interval '12 months' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

WITH a AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', max(raised_on))::date AS m FROM theme.ops_distortion), months AS (SELECT generate_series((SELECT m FROM a) - interval '11 months', (SELECT m FROM a), interval '1 month')::date AS m) SELECT to_char(months.m, 'YYYY-MM') AS "month", count(x.*) AS "reports", count(x.*) FILTER (WHERE x.converted_to_violation) AS "convertedToViolation" FROM months LEFT JOIN theme.ops_distortion x ON date_trunc('month', x.raised_on) = months.m GROUP BY months.m ORDER BY months.m

SELECT count(*) AS "violations", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.closed_date IS NULL) AS "open", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.stage = 'awareness') AS "awareness", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.stage = 'warning') AS "warning", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.stage = 'fine') AS "fine", round(coalesce(sum(x.fine_amount), 0), 0) AS "fineAed", round(coalesce(sum(x.received_amount), 0), 0) AS "receivedAed", CASE WHEN sum(x.fine_amount) > 0 THEN round(100.0 * coalesce(sum(x.received_amount), 0) / sum(x.fine_amount), 1) END AS "collectionPct", max(x.raised_on)::date AS "asOf" FROM theme.ops_violation x WHERE NOT coalesce(x.is_duplicate, false)

SELECT coalesce(nullif(x.${dim}, ''), 'Unknown') AS "k", count(*) AS "n", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.closed_date IS NULL) AS "open", round(coalesce(sum(x.fine_amount), 0), 0) AS "fineAed" FROM theme.ops_violation x WHERE NOT coalesce(x.is_duplicate, false) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS "cases", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.closed_date IS NULL) AS "open", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.is_urgent) AS "urgent", round(coalesce(sum(x.fine_amount), 0), 0) AS "fineAed" FROM theme.ops_occupancy_case x WHERE true
SELECT coalesce(nullif(x.${dim}, ''), 'Unknown') AS "k", count(*) AS "n" FROM theme.ops_occupancy_case x WHERE true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'distortion' AS "type", x.issue_number AS "number", x.raised_on AS "raisedOn", x.closed_date AS "closedOn", x.status AS "status", coalesce(x.violation_name, x.service_name) AS "item", NULL::numeric AS "fineAed", x.within_sla AS "withinSla" FROM theme.ops_distortion x WHERE x.plot_key = #{plot} UNION ALL SELECT 'violation', x.issue_number, x.raised_on, x.closed_date, coalesce(x.issue_status, x.status), coalesce(x.violation_name, x.service_name), x.fine_amount, NULL FROM theme.ops_violation x WHERE x.plot_key = #{plot} AND NOT coalesce(x.is_duplicate, false) UNION ALL SELECT 'occupancy', x.issue_number, x.raised_on, x.closed_date, x.status, coalesce(x.current_activity, x.violation_name), x.fine_amount, NULL FROM theme.ops_occupancy_case x WHERE x.plot_key = #{plot} ) q ORDER BY "raisedOn" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT count(*) AS "units", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.is_rented) AS "rented", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.is_rented = false) AS "vacant", AS "occupancyPct", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.blocked) AS "blocked", count(x.unit_key) AS "linkedUnits" FROM theme.mkt_unit_status x WHERE true

SELECT coalesce(nullif(x.${dim}, ''), 'Unknown') AS "k", count(*) AS "units", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.is_rented) AS "rented", AS "occupancyPct" FROM theme.mkt_unit_status x WHERE true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT u.unit_key AS "unitKey", u.unit_number AS "unitNumber", x.is_rented AS "isRented", x.blocked AS "blocked", CASE WHEN x.blocked THEN 'blocked' WHEN x.is_rented THEN 'rented' WHEN x.is_rented = false THEN 'vacant' END AS "status", x.usage_type AS "usageType", x.classification AS "classification", x.area_sqm AS "areaSqm" FROM theme.mkt_unit_status x JOIN theme.sp_unit u ON u.unit_key = x.unit_key WHERE u.floor_key = #{floor}u.unit_key = #{unit} ORDER BY u.unit_number LIMIT 500

SELECT x.district_key AS "key", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.delayed) AS "delayed", count(*) AS "projects", round(coalesce(sum(x.approved_budget) FILTER (WHERE x.delayed), 0), 0) AS "delayedBudgetAed" FROM theme.dev_capital_project x WHERE x.district_key IS NOT NULL AND x.municipality_code = #{municipality} GROUP BY 1

SELECT x.district_key AS "key", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.is_rented IS NOT NULL) AS "units", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.is_rented) AS "rented" FROM theme.mkt_unit_status x WHERE x.district_key IS NOT NULL AND x.municipality_code = #{municipality} GROUP BY 1

WITH a AS (SELECT max(raised_on)::date AS d FROM theme.ops_distortion) SELECT x.district_key AS "key", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.within_sla IS NOT NULL) AS "reports", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.within_sla) AS "fixed" FROM theme.ops_distortion x WHERE x.district_key IS NOT NULL AND x.raised_on > (SELECT d FROM a) - interval '12 months' AND x.municipality_code = #{municipality} GROUP BY 1

SELECT table_name AS "table", row_count AS "rows", note AS "note" FROM theme.meta_table WHERE table_name IN ('dev_capital_project', 'dev_permit', 'dev_building_application', 'ops_case', 'ops_accident', 'ops_distortion', 'ops_violation', 'ops_occupancy_case', 'mkt_unit_status')
